reviews.text: I’m really impressed with this product! The quality is excellent and it works exactly as described. It’s clear that a lot of thought went into the design and functionality — everything feels durable and easy to use. I’ve noticed a real improvement since I started using it, and it’s quickly become something I rely on every day. The packaging was neat, and delivery was fast, too. -chatgpt
reviews.zh: 對呢款產品印象非常好！品質優異，完全同描述一樣。睇得出設計同功能上花咗唔少心思——每樣嘢都好耐用又好用。自從開始用之後真係見到明顯改善，已經好快變成我每日必用嘅嘢。包裝整齊，送貨都快。-chatgpt

reviews.text: Soothing and refreshing—my skin instantly feels calm and hydrated after each use. Perfect for sensitive skin days, and I love how gentle yet effective it is.
reviews.zh: 舒緩又清爽——每次用完皮膚即刻覺得平靜同保濕。敏感肌嘅日子啱晒，我好鍾意佢咁溫和但又有效。

reviews.text: bought bc jake was on the cover, ended up loving it as someone with really red skin- lol
reviews.zh: 因為 jake 喺封面所以買咗，最後作為一個皮膚好容易泛紅嘅人嚟講我竟然愛上咗佢 - lol

reviews.text: Me justo mucho, tenía varios granitos y si senti que me calmó un poco la rojes, es ligero y se absorbe rápido, se adapto muy bien a mi piel
reviews.zh: 啱晒我用，我有好幾粒暗瘡，確實覺得佢有舒緩到少少泛紅，質地清爽而且吸收得好快，皮膚好受落

reviews.text: I use this as a first step and right before I moisturize . I put a spray cap on to use it as a mist and it’s perfect. Watery and light but I can see how it improves any irritation on my skin. I also use it as a refresher throughout the day when I’m home and my skin feels dry or tight.
reviews.zh: 我喺護膚第一步同搽保濕之前用。我裝咗個噴頭當噴霧用，啱晒。水狀輕盈，但見到可以改善皮膚嘅刺激感。喺屋企成日都會用嚟 refresh，特別係皮膚覺得乾燥或者繃緊嘅時候。

reviews.text: Todos mis productos llegaron en un buen estado y súper rápido, estoy amando mis productos ❤️
reviews.zh: 所有產品都狀態良好而且送到好快，我好鍾意我嘅產品 ❤️

reviews.text: Es la primera vez que lo uso, pero no me quejo me deja mi piel hidratada
reviews.zh: 係第一次用，但冇投訴，用完皮膚好保濕

reviews.text: I really like this toner. My skin is on the dry side, and after cleansing, I go in with this toner. The texture is like water and absorbs quickly on the skin. It leaves my skin refreshed, and I love it. The size is also really nice, it will last you a while.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款爽膚水。我皮膚偏乾，洗面之後就會用呢款爽膚水。質地好似水一樣，喺皮膚上吸收得好快。用完皮膚好清爽，我好鍾意。容量都好好，可以用好耐。
